about: the ruled election close (check_election_close.py): per case the ask's standing and the seating's election closed for the reader, the key view read over the seat and key rows where the case has keys

cases.name: rule 2: the honest election: the opening (A, B, C of five) at g, C three to two; closed by A, B and D
rule 2: an opening by two of five (A, B) concludes nothing, and nothing is seated
rule 2: a room of one opens and seats alone (floor min(2, members))
rule 2: an opening at an old head (it holds aX, X's admission after g, and names g as its head) concludes nothing, and nothing is seated
rule 3: the electorate is the roster at the opening's heads: X, admitted after the opening, does not vote
rule 1: two concurrent lay-downs of A's seat (lm and A's backdated lm0) are a fork: an opening citing either concludes nothing where it holds both, and nothing is seated
rule 1: a holder's lay-down concurrent with a counted end (B, C, D recall A) is no fork: the recall is the end, and the opening citing it seats C
rule 4: two openings for one end, neither in the other's past (A B C and C D E): contested, neither in force, and no seating of either stands for a reader holding both
rule 4: and an opening with both in its past resolves: it is the election, the rivals' ballots are void, and the members vote again under it
rule 6: a fresh reader (no acknowledgement) holding two rival openings gets no closed answer: it waits
rule 7: one person, one say in the close: P's two devices (P1 genesis, C added) receipt once; A, B and the person P (via C and P1) are three of four other: closed
rule 7: an ended key's receipt is no say: D revoked itself after 0, holding its founding signature and its ballot, not its receipt: A and B are two of four: not closed

rule 7: the winner's acceptance through the key view: C revoked itself after 0, holding its founding signature, its cosign of the opening and its ballot, not its seating: C's seating concludes nothing
rule 7: a ballot's withdrawal by an ended key is no withdrawal: D, revoked holding its founding signature and its ballot, withdraws the ballot after: D's ballot counts, C three to two
rule 2: an opening citing no seat end (the founding row) concludes nothing
rule 7: a decline by an ended key is no decline: E, revoked holding its founding signature and its ballot, declines after: C still wins
rule 5: a removal the reader's roster does not take leaves the base unchanged: a counted removal of D signed by A alone concludes nothing, and D's receipt still counts: closed

rule 7: an opening's voices through the key view: D, revoked holding its founding signature (not the opening), cosigns the opening with A and B: D is no voice of it, A and B are two of five: it concludes nothing, nothing is seated (D casts no ballot)
rule 2 by persons: the room seats A and both of person P's keys (P1 and its device C); an opening signed by P1 and C is one person of two: concludes nothing, and nothing is seated
rule 5: a contested pair of counted removals (A, B, C remove D; C, D, E remove A, concurrently) is taken by no roster: no departure and no fork of A's lay-down; A, B and D receipt C's seating: closed
r103 attack_block: two founders' stale recall of A at g (concluded, taken by no roster: S'' over the rows held) forks nothing: the honest close holds, D moderates
and for a reader that acknowledged aG
and with an opening citing the stale recall at g: still the honest close
a truly backdated opening (B and C open at g citing lm, which g does not hold) concludes nothing: the honest close holds

r103 attack_stale: B and C run a whole election at g (recall, removal of A, opening, ballots, B's seating, C's receipt): taken by no roster: B is not moderator and the election is not closed, for a reader with no acknowledgement
and for a reader that acknowledged aG
r104 one view of a seat end: A's stale lay-down lm0 (only g in its past) and the honest election at aG citing it: for a reader with no acknowledgement, D moderates and ed is closed
and for a reader that acknowledged aG: lm0 is behind its line, so its roster takes it no more than its election does: A keeps the seat for it, and ed is not closed for it
and once that reader acknowledges D's seating (built on lm0): lm0 is on its line: D moderates, ed is closed
G3c plus C (r90-49): A's backdated lay-down forks the end; C's receipt of B's seating closes nothing, and B is not seated
